metadata.chapter_subtitle: Temperature, photoperiod, and the timing of leaf emergence and senescence

inventory.summary: The phenology chapter already had a strong climatic hook and clear math, but it needed the same reader-facing onboarding now used across the series.
issues: The chapter lacked a Before You Start section despite introducing several linked seasonal controls.
Readers benefit from an explicit framing of threshold accumulation before the formal GDD and photoperiod equations.
The topic-library environmental set needed more consistent chapter-entry design.

rewrite.summary: Added learner-facing onboarding and preserved the thermal-time, photoperiod, and growing-season modelling structure.
editor_notes: Added a Before You Start section.
Used the setup block to foreground the cue-accumulation logic.
Kept the worked GDD example and seasonal dynamics intact.

qa_review.summary: The chapter now introduces seasonal threshold logic more gently while preserving the mathematical treatment of GDD, photoperiod, and senescence.

repair.summary: The repair focused on conceptual pacing and onboarding rather than on changing the model itself.
actions_taken: Added a Before You Start section.
Clarified the cue-threshold logic before the equations.
Preserved the chapter's seasonal modelling and worked example.

design_review.summary: The chapter already uses seasonal explainers and interactive support well, and the revised opening improves interpretive access to those elements.
improvements_made: Added learner-facing prerequisites and focus guidance.
Retained the chapter's strong seasonal and threshold-based explanation.
Improved interpretive support around the idea of accumulated cues.
